summary: Completed backend (pytest, 10/10 passing) and frontend E2E (Playwright) testing of CompeteIQ dashboard. Auth (login/register/protected routes/logout), demo data seeding (NimbusIQ + Datadog/Dynatrace/New Relic + insights), all 6 nav routes, Add Competitor dialog, action-status pill cycle, methodology modal, SWOT, Compare sort headers, Settings save/reset all work. Live GPT-5.4 analyze + regenerate-insights calls were validated only structurally (buttons present + backend endpoints not re-executed due to 30-90s cost) but backend endpoints confirmed by main agent via curl.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins from env is correct; however since frontend uses Bearer tokens (localStorage), credentials cookie handling is unused. Not a bug.
scrape_website uses requests.get synchronously inside an async endpoint – blocks the event loop during 30-90s scrape+AI. Consider run_in_threadpool or httpx AsyncClient for scalability.
AI response parsing regex r'\{.*\}' is greedy and depends on LLM producing valid JSON; falls back only via json.loads. Consider try/except + retry with reformat prompt for robustness.
No rate limiting on /auth/login – vulnerable to brute force. Consider adding.

demo_data seeding is per-user but idempotent guard only checks company doc. If company deleted but competitors remain, /reset-demo handles it correctly, but seed_user_data used at login could get partial state. Low risk.

email is stored lowercased on register/login but not enforced by unique index (index is on original case). Since login lowercases before lookup this is fine, but adding a collation or lowercase-only index would be safer.
seed_data_creation: One test competitor 'TEST UI Competitor' (example.com) left on demo account from Add Competitor UI test; can be removed via Reset Demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). All 10 tests pass in ~3s. Frontend testids verified: nav-{dashboard,competitors,compare,ai-insights,swot-matrix,settings}, add-competitor-btn, add-{name,website,product,category,target,notes}, analyze-<id>, action-status-<id> (cycles Not Started->In Progress->Completed), regenerate-insights-btn (on both Dashboard + Insights), save-company-btn, reset-demo-btn, methodology-btn, sort-<key> (8 sort headers on Compare). Logout icon in sidebar (aria-label logout). Protected routes redirect to /login when localStorage.ciq_token missing. Live analyze/insights-generate were NOT re-run in this iteration to avoid 30-90s cost; main agent already validated via curl.
